skill.displayName: skill 作品集增长审计 · Skill Portfolio Growth Audit

version.changelog: discoverability fix - 中文名补齐 + topics 换入中文零竞争词; 内容零变更, No behavior change.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent portfolio-audit guide that uses public ClawHub registry/search evidence and local repository review to recommend strategy, without hidden execution or persistence.

dimensions.detail: The expected access is public registry/search data and relevant repository content for the publisher's skills; no unrelated local indexing, credential use, or broad private data collection is instructed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Metadata requires git and installs the node package/bin `clawhub`, which is proportionate for querying ClawHub registry data but should still be accepted knowingly by the user.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives conservative decision gates and evidence boundaries, but most user-facing guidance is Chinese-only, so users should expect a Chinese-language workflow unless adapted.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background workers, scheduled tasks, memory writes, privilege escalation, destructive actions, or automatic mutation of skills/plugins are present in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to audit a publisher's ClawHub skill portfolio using downloads, installs, search competition, version health, and repository evidence; the instructions and templates match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable with a Chinese-language ClawHub portfolio-audit workflow and with the `clawhub` CLI being used to gather public registry/search evidence. Review any recommendations before acting, especially merge, stop-maintenance, or new-skill decisions; the skill itself does not instruct automatic changes.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The cited line is a normal repository-quality checklist item asking the agent to compare `SKILL.md` with catalog metadata; it is not analysis evasion, and the referenced local artifacts were available and inspected.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only instructions, examples, references, changelog, and template are real, but this is a locale/usability note rather than evidence of hidden behavior, excessive authority, or malicious activity.
[A.I.G SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no T01-T09 security findings, which is consistent with the artifact being markdown guidance plus templates rather than executable code.
